summary: readsb 3.16.17+lab1: wiedehopf/readsb v3.16.17 (0947209) for RTL-SDR only against the lab librtlsdr2, bias tee compiled out, no interactive mode, no viewadsb; the readsb binary only

packages.name: readsb
packages.description: Mode S/ADS-B 1090 MHz decoder, receive-only lab build: RTL-SDR only, bias tee compiled out, run only in srrx-lease-readsb@.service behind srrx.adsb_filter

notes: Upstream Makefile at 0947209: RTLSDR ?= no (:4) and the other SDR switches default to no (:5-8); RTLSDR=yes adds sdr_rtlsdr.o and pkg-config librtlsdr from the lab librtlsdr-dev (:126-148). HAVE_BIASTEE=no keeps ENABLE_RTLSDR_BIASTEE undefined (:130-132), so sdr_rtlsdr.c never calls rtlsdr_set_bias_tee (sdr_rtlsdr.c:329-332); the hidden --enable-biastee option text stays in help.h:103 but only sets a flag nothing reads for RTL-SDR, so the check forbids the call's symbol, not the word biastee. The other SDR switches are passed as no explicitly.

READSB_VERSION on the command line replaces Makefile:2, which would embed git describe or the build date (`date +%y%m%d`) when the tree has no .git; a value without spaces needs none of the shell quoting of Makefile:2 and :26. READSB_SHORT_COMMIT (:28) falls back to nogit in the chroot, which has no repository above the source tree; both builds of --repeat see the same text.

Only the readsb target is built (Makefile:191-196): viewadsb, a copy of the binary (:198-200), is not. DISABLE_INTERACTIVE=yes drops ncurses (:62-70). DISABLE_RTLSDR_ZEROCOPY_WORKAROUND=yes because the lab librtlsdr is built with ENABLE_ZEROCOPY=OFF (rtlsdr recipe), as Makefile:72-75 asks.

Upstream CFLAGS are kept (-O2 -g -fstack-protector-strong -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2, Makefile:25-35); the debian/ directory of the tree (systemd service, default file, adduser postinst) is not used: the only unit is software/systemd/srrx-lease-readsb@.service, and no tar1090 web UI is packaged.
GPL v3 or later (LICENSE of the pinned tree). CI build only (CI_BUILT_UNREVIEWED): 1090 MHz reception on a Q6A and the accepted aircraft.csv.gz at the home base stay OPEN.
